title: Understanding Clustering
text: Clustering is a method of unsupervised learning where the goal is to group similar data points together. It is often used when the data does not have predefined labels.

title: K-Means Clustering
text: K-Means is a popular clustering algorithm that requires the user to specify the number of clusters (k) in advance. The algorithm then partitions the data into k clusters by minimizing the variance within each cluster.

title: Choosing the Number of Clusters
text: Choosing the right number of clusters is crucial for the performance of K-Means. Techniques like the Elbow Method or Silhouette Analysis can help determine the optimal number of clusters.
